channel.title: Candlelit Chronicles: History for Sleep
channel.description: Slow, calm journeys through ordinary life in the past, told gently so you can drift off to sleep. New episode every week. Narration and illustrations are AI-assisted.
channel.itunes:author: Candlelit Chronicles

item.title: Medieval Winter Night
item.description: Journey back to a fourteenth-century longhouse to discover how our ancestors stayed warm during the coldest nights of the year. From the communal heat of livestock to the science of the central hearth, explore the quiet, sensory details of medieval winter life. Sources include historical records of domestic architecture and textile history from the Middle Ages.
